name: Insert Coin Club
tagline: 1 follower = 1 arcade machine. The hall grows every day.

episodes.title: Day 1: one machine
episodes.summary: 1 follower = 1 arcade machine. One machine today, the FOUNDER cabinet, and a whole arcade to fill. What game belongs here?

episodes.title: Day 2: 65 machines
episodes.summary: Yesterday it was one machine. Today 64 new followers lit up 64 new machines, so the hall has 65. Your names are on the machines. Find yours.

episodes.title: Day 3: 237 machines
episodes.summary: Yesterday the hall had 65 machines. Today it has 237: 172 new machines, one for each new follower. Everyone who commented got a named cabinet. What game belongs here next?
